page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan. Left page: only a narrow strip of its outer margin is visible, carrying dense marginal notes in a small italic type, mostly unreadable. Right page: one column of running text with hanging Greek and Latin entries, a centred section letter, and a drop-capped entry at the foot. The signature sits at the lower right.

main_text.p: Βηθσαιδα ας ἡ nomen loci, Heb. domus transitus, Johan.1.28.
Βηθαυία ας ἡ nomen villa, Hebr. domus afflictionis.
Βηθεσδὰ ἡ nomen piscina, Syr. domus h.e. locus misericordiæ.
Βηθλεὲμ ἡ nomen urbis Hebr. ἀχλιζν, domus panis. q.d. locus ubi frumentorum & pabulorum est copia. Vocatur πόλις Δαβὶδ urbs Davidis, Luc.2.11.
Βηθσαϊδὰ ἡ nomen urbis ἀχλιζν, Hebr. domus piscationis, Johan.1.45.

p.i: Βηθφαγὴ ης ἡ nomen villula in monte oliveti, Hebr. domus ficuum præcocium.

main_text.p: Βιθυνία ας ἡ nomen reg. Gr. q.d. βαθυνία fovea.
Βλάς ὁ nomen viri, Gr. germen.
Βοοζ ὁ nomen viri, Hebr. in quo robur.
Βοος 2.Pet.2.15. sparsor Hebr. qui etiam dicitur βεὼρ Num.22.5. pater Balaami, Hebr. ardere, obbrutescere.
ΓΑββαδ̃ ἡ nomen platea, Heb. pavimentum elatum.
Γαβριὴλ ὁ nomen angeli ἀχλιτν, Hebr. robur DEI.
Γὰδ Gad nomen viri, Hebr. turma, Gen.30.11. Apoc.7.8.

page.notes: The left page is only a fragment at the edge of the scan: its marginal notes are small, italic and cut off, so they cannot be transcribed reliably and are omitted. Greek entries on the right page are copied as far as legible; the accents and the exact letters of Βεροιαῖος, Βηθσαιδὰ, Βηθαυία, Βηθεσδὰ, Βηθλεὲμ, Βηθσαϊδὰ, Βηθφαγὴ, Βιθυνία and Βοος are uncertain and may differ from the printed forms. The Hebrew-derived glosses ("domus", "robur") are transcribed as printed.
